name: LaunchDarkly
description: LaunchDarkly is a feature management platform for feature flags, progressive delivery, targeting, experimentation, release governance, and controlled software changes.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated Reader-role access token and bind one commercial, EU, or federal instance to one non-production project and environment. Relay approval-gates a 25-item summary list and one exact redacted flag read; targeting, variation values, evaluations, experiments, and every mutation remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: LAUNCHDARKLY_READER_API_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: LaunchDarkly Reader API access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated Reader-role personal or service access token.

credentialRequirements.name: LAUNCHDARKLY_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: LaunchDarkly instance
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter exactly commercial, eu, or federal.

credentialRequirements.name: LAUNCHDARKLY_PROJECT_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: LaunchDarkly project key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production project.

credentialRequirements.name: LAUNCHDARKLY_ENVIRONMENT_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: LaunchDarkly environment key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production environment.

capabilities.label: Read feature flags
capabilities.description: Read bounded, redacted project/environment feature flags with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read LaunchDarkly flags
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded project/environment flag summaries or one exact redacted flag.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: API access tokens, authorization headers, stored region/project/environment routing, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read targeting or variation values
blocked.description: Context targets, user/team/member identities, clauses, rule values, prerequisites, variation/config payloads, evaluations, experiments, metrics, code references, and migration cohorts are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate LaunchDarkly
blocked.description: Flag creation, updates, enable/disable, rollout/targeting changes, archive/delete, experiments, segments, approvals, projects, environments, tokens, roles, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only list and exact feature-flag GETs run on enumerated commercial/EU/federal origins with stored project/environment binding and API version 20240415; arbitrary paths, query expansion, pagination, raw API, SDK evaluation, events, exports, and audit logs are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded feature-flag reads require approval; Reader token authority, exact instance/project/environment binding, response bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected redacted feature-flag read runs without Relay per-action approval; Reader token authority, exact instance/project/environment binding, response bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted Reader token server-side and mounts two versioned, project/environment-bound, approval-gated, redacted flag reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted Reader token server-side and mounts two versioned, project/environment-bound, approval-gated, redacted flag reads.

providerSetup.blocker: LaunchDarkly requires a customer account, a dedicated Reader-role access token, the correct commercial/EU/federal instance, and one non-production project/environment. No console, account, token, project, environment, flag, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated Reader-role token outside this worker, configure its encrypted value, instance, project and environment in Railway staging, then verify binding, list/exact redaction, approval/access denial, 1 MB/25-item bounds, 20240415 versioning, rate limiting, token reset/revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: LaunchDarkly documents access-token authentication, commercial/EU/federal REST origins, explicit API versioning, and 20240415 as the current stable version.
LaunchDarkly documents Reader-scoped personal/service access tokens, least privilege, immutable service-token permissions, secret handling, token reset, and deletion.
LaunchDarkly documents GET list/exact flag routes, project and environment binding, summary mode that omits targets/rules, 25-item pagination controls, and sensitive fields Relay strips.
